The 2026-08-09 scheduled live-drift run (Actions run 31330856982) still reports 21 missing_live indexes spanning many migrations, 2 unexpected_live indexes, and def_hash mismatches on 10 match_* retrieval RPCs (protected RAG surface — diff before touching).
